verdict.rationale: ReelMimic has its own in-app chat. Users state what they want, refine the plan in the right-hand chat panel and approve it, and multiple agents then build and review the video with visible logs. The caveat is that the assistant is not self-contained: it runs on the user's own Claude Code or Codex, which must be set up separately. Missing for 10: a self-contained built-in AI model that needs no external Claude Code/Codex install, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor README.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
